papers.title: Neural Collaborative Filtering
papers.abstract: We propose Neural Collaborative Filtering (NCF) replacing inner products with neural architectures on MovieLens and Pinterest.
papers.full_text_excerpt: Section 5 Conclusion: Neural architectures capture non-linear user-item interactions; systematic hyperparameter sweeps across tuned neighborhood models remain future work.

papers.title: Variational Autoencoders for Collaborative Filtering
papers.abstract: We extend variational autoencoders to collaborative filtering for implicit feedback.
papers.full_text_excerpt: Section 4 Results: Mult-VAE outperforms matrix factorization baselines on MovieLens-20M and Netflix.

papers.title: Are We Really Making Much Progress? A Worrying Analysis of Recent Neural Recommendation Approaches
papers.abstract: Tuned simple neighborhood baselines such as ItemKNN outperform 6 of 7 recent neural recommendation models under matched evaluation protocols.
papers.full_text_excerpt: Section 4 Table 2: Tuned ItemKNN reaches 0.338 NDCG@10 vs 0.312 for neural baselines, closing claimed neural superiority over neighborhood methods.
